answer_1.quote: We apply the NND framework to three NLG tasks: question generation, question answering, and summarization...
answer_1.outputs: Generated questions, generated answers, generated summaries

answer_2.quote: We compare NND to standard n-gram based evaluation metrics: BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, as well as more recent Transformer-based metrics: BERTScore, BARTScore and QuestEval.

answer_4.quote: Ten teachers designing educational quizzes annotated 3,164 questions with one of four error types: No Error, Disfluent, Off Target, Wrong Context.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators labeled each generated question with one of the error categories (No Error, Disfluent, Off Target, Wrong Context).
